entryFields.recordId: existing catalogue or device-documents ID, never invented
entryFields.title: specific diagram/page topic
entryFields.category: record category exactly, for existing manual discipline filters
models: only models/part codes actually established by this source and page scope
panelIds: existing panel IDs only where source establishes applicability
deviceIds: existing device IDs only where source establishes applicability
entryFields.printedPage: string or null; do not infer printed number from PDF index
entryFields.section: actual caption/section or precise page topic
entryFields.sourceUrl: retrieved source PDF URL, normally existing record.url
entryFields.edition: actual edition/revision or Edition not stated
entryFields.scope: brief page/model/circuit applicability including relevant variants
notes: necessary limitations/conditions already in source; no invented instructions

sourceRules: Only visually checked actual manufacturer manual pages; no generated/redrawn wiring or inferred cross-model compatibility.
Render complete page by default so legends, conditions and neighbouring figures remain. Document crop bounds if absolutely necessary.
Use lossless WebP at about 1400 pixels page width (increase if small print requires it). Keep diagrams legible; do not optimize by removing labels.
Do not change catalogue records, pack membership, manual URLs, device/panel IDs or existing PDF hashes.
An image of terminals alone must be called a terminal layout, not a complete wiring diagram.
Record every retrieved PDF's source URL/hash/edition/local filename and selected pages in a batch audit, including retrieval failures and skipped candidates.
One page may contain several connection drawings; preserve them together and describe all relevant variant conditions.
No diagram found means not yet included, never proof that a device has no wiring. Archive coverage must be reported honestly.
